newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ATHERTON REAPPOINTED AS ENGLAND CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ATHERTON REAPPOINTED AS ENGLAND CAPTAIN.

text.p: Michael Atherton was reappointed on Monday as England captain for the forthcoming test and one-day series against Australia.
Atherton, 29 last month, is now in line to equal Peter May's all-time record of 41 tests as England captain when the six-test Ashes series starts at Edgbaston on June 5.
Wicketkeeper-batsman Alec Stewart was also named as England's player of the year at an eve-of-season lunch in London.
